speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Given your recent travel, hiking, and camping, have you noticed any mosquito bites, rash, joint pain, or issues with your vision or swallowing?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
REQUEST TEST: Malaria_Smear

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work and malaria smear are normal, which rules out those causes. Given your recent hiking, have you had any difficulty breathing or shortness of breath, or any history of heart palpitations?

REQUEST TEST: Electrocardiogram (ECG)
REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas

speaker: Doctor
text:
The ECG and arterial blood gas results are normal, which helps rule out cardiac and acute respiratory causes for your fatigue. Given your recent outdoor activities, have you noticed any new joint pain, muscle weakness, or swelling in your legs?

REQUEST TEST: Erythrocyte_Sedimentation_Rate
REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Phosphokinase

speaker: Doctor
text:
The ESR and CK results are normal, which helps rule out inflammatory myopathies and significant muscle damage. With cardiac and infectious causes excluded, have you noticed any recent weight loss, cold intolerance, constipation, or hair thinning?

REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone (TSH)
REQUEST TEST: Free_T4

speaker: Doctor
text:
The TSH and Free T4 results are normal, which effectively rules out thyroid dysfunction as a cause for your fatigue. We have now excluded infectious, cardiac, respiratory, and inflammatory causes, as well as thyroid issues. To further narrow the differential, have you noticed any changes in your menstrual cycle, skin pigmentation, or oral health issues?

REQUEST TEST: Iron_Ferritin
REQUEST TEST: Vitamin_B12

speaker: Doctor
text:
The iron and B12 levels are normal, which rules out common nutritional deficiencies. Given your history of multiple recent illnesses and current weakness, have you noticed any dark urine, jaundice, or significant changes in your bowel habits?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Test
REQUEST TEST: Stool_Ova_and_Parasites

speaker: Doctor
text:
The liver function and stool tests are normal, ruling out hepatic causes and parasitic infections. Given your extensive hiking and camping, have you noticed any generalized itching, jaundice, or changes in your urine color, or perhaps a "flu-like" illness a few weeks after returning?

REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_Serology
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis

speaker: Doctor
text:
The Hepatitis serology and urinalysis are normal, ruling out hepatic dysfunction and urinary tract issues. At this point, we have excluded infectious, cardiac, respiratory, thyroid, nutritional, and hepatic causes. Did your symptoms of weakness and fatigue start specifically after waking up in the morning or after prolonged periods of standing, and do you feel significantly better after eating?

REQUEST TEST: Cortisol_Levels
REQUEST TEST: Hemoglobin_A1c

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome / Fibromyalgia. The normal workup for infectious, cardiac, metabolic, endocrine, and nutritional causes in the context of persistent, non-specific fatigue and weakness suggests a functional somatic disorder.
